title.zh: 荷兰央行授予Qivalis电子货币牌照，用于符合MiCA的欧元代币
title.en: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token

current_state.zh: 荷兰央行已向 Qivalis 颁发 MiCA 下的电子货币机构牌照；Qivalis 由 37 家欧洲主要银行支持，仍需满足 MiCA 其余要求（包括发布白皮书）并在未来几个月内发行代币，计划通过银行、交易所和支付服务提供商分发。
current_state.en: The Dutch central bank granted Qivalis an EMI license under MiCA; Qivalis is backed by 37 major European banks, still needs to meet remaining MiCA requirements including whitepaper, plans to issue token in coming months, and will distribute via banks, exchanges, and payment service providers.

updates.title_zh: 荷兰央行授予Qivalis电子货币牌照，用于符合MiCA的欧元代币
updates.title_en: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token
updates.what_changed_zh: 荷兰央行根据MiCA授予Qivalis电子货币机构牌照，使这家银行支持的合资企业能够提供符合MiCA的链上欧元结算基础设施。
updates.what_changed_en: The Dutch central bank granted Qivalis an electronic money institution license under MiCA, enabling the bank-backed venture to offer MiCA-compliant onchain euro settlement infrastructure.
updates.current_state_zh: 荷兰央行根据MiCA授予Qivalis电子货币机构牌照，使这家银行支持的合资企业能够提供符合MiCA的链上欧元结算基础设施。
updates.current_state_en: The Dutch central bank granted Qivalis an electronic money institution license under MiCA, enabling the bank-backed venture to offer MiCA-compliant onchain euro settlement infrastructure.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Dutch central bank granted Qivalis an electronic money institution license under MiCA, enabling the bank-backed venture to offer MiCA-compliant onchain euro settlement infrastructure.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Dutch central bank granted Qivalis an electronic money institution license under MiCA, enabling the bank-backed venture to offer MiCA-compliant onchain euro settlement infrastructure.

updates.title_zh: 【荷兰央行向 Qivalis 颁发符合 MiCA 标准的欧元代币电子货币牌照】
updates.title_en: 【荷兰央行向 Qivalis 颁发符合 MiCA 标准的欧元代币电子货币牌照】
updates.what_changed_zh: 披露 Qivalis 由 37 家欧洲主要银行支持，需满足 MiCA 其余要求（包括发布白皮书）后方可发行代币，计划未来几个月内发行，并通过银行、加密货币交易所和支付服务提供商分发，而非直接面向消费者。
updates.what_changed_en: Disclosed that Qivalis is backed by 37 major European banks, must meet remaining MiCA requirements including publishing a whitepaper before token issuance, plans issuance in coming months, and will distribute via banks, crypto exchanges and payment service providers rather than directly to consumers.
updates.current_state_zh: 荷兰央行已向 Qivalis 颁发 MiCA 下的电子货币机构牌照；Qivalis 由 37 家欧洲主要银行支持，仍需满足 MiCA 其余要求（包括发布白皮书）并在未来几个月内发行代币，计划通过银行、交易所和支付服务提供商分发。
updates.current_state_en: The Dutch central bank granted Qivalis an EMI license under MiCA; Qivalis is backed by 37 major European banks, still needs to meet remaining MiCA requirements including whitepaper, plans to issue token in coming months, and will distribute via banks, exchanges, and payment service providers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Dutch central bank granted Qivalis — a consortium backed by 37 major European banks — an electronic money institution license for its MiCA-compliant euro token, with issuance planned in the coming months pending a whitepaper and remaining MiCA requirements.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Dutch central bank granted Qivalis — a consortium backed by 37 major European banks — an electronic money institution license for its MiCA-compliant euro token, with issuance planned in the coming months pending a whitepaper and remaining MiCA requirements.
